economic_profit_model.formula: Net Economic Profit = (Goods Value Acquired + Recoverable Mule Proceeds) - (Payer-Owned Debit + Actual Attacker Costs)
economic_profit_model.goods_value_acquired: Face value of goods/services released at POS by honest merchants upon offline verification
economic_profit_model.mule_account_payout: Gross nominal settlement disbursed to mule accounts
economic_profit_model.frozen_or_reversed_funds: Funds clawed back or frozen prior to cashout
economic_profit_model.payer_owned_debit: C + H actual funds disbursed from payer balances (0 if victim)
